name: brains-heist-bubble-sheet-demo
description: Animated explainer video: Brains Heist paper assignments, printed bubble sheets, phone scanning and automatic grading.

scripts.record:desktop: node capture/record.mjs desktop && node capture/prepare.mjs desktop
scripts.record:mobile: node capture/record.mjs mobile && node capture/prepare.mjs mobile
scripts.render:desktop: remotion render src/index.ts DesktopDemo out/brains-heist-paper-desktop.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20
scripts.render:mobile: remotion render src/index.ts MobileDemo out/brains-heist-paper-mobile.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20
